description: The Rubbermaid Commercial Toilet Brush is ideal for commercial, medical, and industrial applications. The sturdy plastic toilet bowl brush handle is suited for moderate to heavy cleaning. A hole near the end of the toilet brush handle allows the toilet cleaning brush to be hung for storage. The brown polypropylene bristles are resistant to stains, odors, bacteria, fungi, and wear.
